HRA Analysis: EMERGING DEAL (2) has moderate gate speed and may be able to press through and find the lead early in this race which would make her the one to beat. She appeared to be a touch unlucky last time out in a race which was taken out by Set Play. GIRL POWER (3) was able to find the front three starts ago taking them all the way there to beat Maywyn Valentino. She has since raced with less luck and may be better suited in this race. MALARKY (6) has been impressive in recent outings including a good win two starts ago rating fast time when beating subsequent winner The Torque Effect. She draws awkwardly in this race but should run well again. LACEYS LASS (1) should settle close enough behind the speed in this race. She ran well for third last time out in a race which was taken out by Azzif. SELECTIONS: EMERGING DEAL (2), GIRL POWER (3), MALARKY (6), LACEYS LASS (1) SUGGESTED BET: EMERGING DEAL (2) to win.

WALK WITH ELEGANCE (2) took on a strong race last time out when finishing fourth last time out behind Aardies A Star and Exit Eleven. She had trialled up nicely finishing second to Shards Eclipse in a trial and should run well second up in this race. FAN THE FLAME (5) took on a strong race last time out when securing a good run and just fading out of it late. She ran a good race three starts ago when sitting without cover and battling on well there for second behind Harry The Hat. CRUNCHY TUNA (3) draws reasonably well in this race to settle close in the run. She took on a stronger race last time out when getting back and not running on late in a race taken out by Aardies A Star. She should find this easier and can be running on late. VERA AGUILERA (4) trialled up well recently finishing second to Catchafire. She should settle close and with the right run can run top four. SELECTIONS: WALK WITH ELEGANCE (2), FAN THE FLAME (5), CRUNCHY TUNA (3), VERA AGUILERA (4) SUGGESTED BET: WALK WITH ELEGANCE (2) to win.

FIT AND READY (5) was able to sit without cover last time out and proved too good there over Rocky Wine. She may be left to do the work again in this race but should still be very hard to beat in this race. JEWEL REASON (1) was able to lead last time out and proved too good there running out a dominant winner. She has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in this race before having options from there. SHAKE (6) ran well four second two starts ago behind Rebecca Rhayne Bow at this track over the 1660 before running well again last time out. She draws wide and can look to be running on late. MADAM FIRST LADY (2) could be a big improver in this race getting on the pegs at Albion Park from an ideal draw. She made a break last time out which took her out of play there. SELECTIONS: FIT AND READY (5), JEWEL REASON (1), SHAKE (6), MADAM FIRST LADY (2) SUGGESTED BET: FIT AND READY (5) to win.

LOTS OF HEART (5) charged to the line last time out when finishing second behind Scar Struck in fast time. He is a horse which has previously shown good gate speed and if he was able to find the front he would likely be very hard to run down. EXIT ELEVEN (7) appeared to have his chance when leading last time out when run down by Aardies A Star there who was able to sit without cover and prove too good. He draws awkwardly in this race but does have high speed and can be driven a number of ways. PASSION AND PAIN (3) appears to have reasonable gate speed and may look to press forward and hold a prominent position in this race. He sat without cover recently at Newcastle and ran a good third there not beaten too far. JOVIAL JIM (4) sat without cover two starts ago and was able to beat a lesser field there. He draws well this time and shouldn’t be too far away in the run. SELECTIONS: LOTS OF HEART (5), EXIT ELEVEN (7), PASSION AND PAIN (3), JOVIAL JIM (4) SUGGESTED BET: LOTS OF HEART (5) to win.

BLACKJACK SAM (2) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and hold the early lead in this race. He led before handing over to stablemate Bettor One and was able to run a good second. He should be hard to run down. SCAR STRUCK (6) looked to be well suited last time out getting a good run off the speed in a race which there was a genuine tempo which allowed him to run over the top and score rating good time. He draws awkwardly this time and will need the race run to suit again. WHAT IS HIS NAME (5) only beat one home last time out but put in a good effort there appearing to have plenty left to give through the line late. He should get a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on late. AIR FORCE MAJOR (3) won nicely last time out at Redcliffe when finding the front early and taking them all the way. He steps up in grade but draws favourably and shouldn’t be too far away in the run. SELECTIONS: BLACKJACK SAM (2), SCAR STRUCK (6), WHAT IS HIS NAME (5), AIR FORCE MAJOR (3) SUGGESTED BET: BLACKJACK SAM (2) to win.

GUS (9) was a dominant winner of the Group 1 Dominion at Addington making it back to back wins in the race and taking his earnings past $1,000,000 which is a huge achievement. He returns from NZ and finds himself starting from a huge handicap of 55m which does appear to make things tough for him. KEAYANG STUKA (7) was able to cross in the early stages last time out before being run down late by Golden Sunset who has been in excellent form. He starts 35m in front of his main rival in this race GUS (9) and if he could step well and find the front he would likely be incredibly hard to run down. ALDEBARAN ZANE (1) trialled up very nicely recently finishing just 14m off smart pacer Greased Lightnin. He draws well and if he can step well at the start and settle in a prominent position he can run well. SHEETWEB WEAVER (2) looked very sharp in his latest win over the 1660 at this track rating a fast time of 1.54.5. He looks well handicapped in this race and if he can settle in a prominent position and continue his progression run to run in QLD he should run well again. SELECTIONS: GUS (9), KEAYANG STUKA (7), ALDEBARAN ZANE (1), SHEETWEB WEAVER (2) SUGGESTED BET: KEAYANG STUKA (7) to win.

PURE GRUNT (3) has brilliant gate speed and may be able to launch across early in this race to the lead. He trialled up nicely recently at Newcastle when beating Hay There Joe and running home a slick last half. He was the impressive winner of the QBRED Triad final when leading all the way there rating fast time. KIKI MEISTER (8) should get a good run through in this race to settle just behind the speed in the early stages. He has won his latest two outings including last time out beating subsequent winner Magnetic Storm. TIMMYTEO (1) comes into this race third up from a spell having not been beaten far first up when fifth just 1.7m off the winner Bigbashash before running fifth again in a much stronger race taken out by Fire And Passion. BENNYDASOOK (4) ran a good race two starts ago finishing fourth in fast time behind Race For Riches at this track. He should settle close and with the right run can be running into it late. SELECTIONS: PURE GRUNT (3), KIKI MEISTER (8), TIMMYTEO (1), BENNYDASOOK (4) SUGGESTED BET: PURE GRUNT (3) to win.

GOLDEN SUNSET (9) was crossed early last time out but was able to land the position behind the leader and sprinted best to score a nice win over Keayang Stuka. She faces a 30m handicap in this race but should be suited over the 2647m journey and should still be very hard to beat. PINNIE (7) has been excellent since joining the stable of Chantal Turpin in QLD. She was a strong winner last time out when leading a lesser race and taking them all the way beating Get Used To It and Mufasa Metro. If she can step well and settle close she should run well again. LOVE GUN (3) was an impressive winner three starts ago leading all the way and rating good time over the 2138. He appears to be quite well handicapped in this race starting off the front and if he could step to the lead early he would likely take some running down. LEAF STRIDE (2) took on a lesser race last time out where he appeared to have his chance sitting 1 out 1 back and running on just fairly into fourth. He may be better suited in this race starting off the front and if he can secure the right run he can be running on late. SELECTIONS: GOLDEN SUNSET (9), PINNIE (7), LOVE GUN (3), LEAF STRIDE (2) SUGGESTED BET: LOVE GUN (3) each way. MEZZANOTTI (5) returns to a much easier race today after running in the Southern cross series and some tricky races in Melbourne. If she is anywhere near her best she will be the one to beat. CAPTAIN CAROLINE (6), JILLIBY ECLIPSE (1) and CLARENDEN REGALIA (3) are also chances.

LOW LIE THE FIELDS (8) has the runs on the board when it comes to recent form. He has won four of his last five starts and has been hitting the line well. He is a major chance to win again today. MILITARY MERIT (7) is a big threat but he is first up from a spell. If he can get some clear air he will love the mobile start and the distance. NOTHING I WANT (4) has race fitness on her side but she has had chances to win races recently and she hasn’t got the job done. MAJESTIC TUSSLE (3) is a chance but she is first up.

TREACHEROUS DAN (6) gets a major drop down in class today after competing in the Southern Cross series but the draw over the shorter journey is a concern. He will need some luck but he looks a class above. ORSINO BELLE (8) has her first South Australian start for Kaycee Carey. Her NSW form reads well and she is worth consideration today. LIGHTNING BLING (7) and LOCHINVAR HAWK (3) are also chances.

KENZINGTON (8) is very green but she is another who finds a much easier race after competing in the Southern Cross series. If she can pace smoothly she will be hard to beat. JUST VIENNA (4) is showing signs of improvement and she looks like a big threat today as well. ULTIMATE SAFARI (3) and VINNIES HOPE (9) are also chances.

TWIN CONNECTION (9) ran a nice race at Globe Derby last start when he was three wide for a lot of the last lap and ran second behind OHSO KINKY. The second row draw isn’t ideal, but he looks strong enough to overcome it after that terrific run last start. LE GASTON (6) is another who is stepping down in class today after running in the Southern Cross. He is a big threat today. TRIGGER (1) and STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (5) look the next best.

SANTA CASA LANE (4) has shown signs since returning from a long spell and joining the Mel Kittel stable. Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky will make a major difference and if he can repeat some of the form he showed early in his preparation he will be a big chance. B T CAPTIVATE (7) will need some luck from the second row but he is good enough to win this if he can get the right run into the race. TWO WAY WONDER (1) is a good chance of holding the lead from the inside draw. BETTOR LOVER (6) is also a chance.

FIRESIDE (10) was extremely impressive two starts ago but very disappointing last week. He will need to improve off that run but he is a major chance if he is anywhere near his best. PARISIAN BANDIT (8), OAKLANDER (6) and DONT TELL ALICE (5) are all major chances in a very even race. OVERVIEW:MAURLEN COMPASS (2) isn't blessed with gate speed but has been finishing her races off well and drops back significantly in class after a decent performance against much stronger opposition in the Oaks. She'll need to map reasonably well over the distance, but she should appreciate this level and get the chance to show her class in a suitable race. MAJOR ORION (3) is a quick beginner and looks likely to cross to the pegs and lead these, which is a big advantage at Echuca, particularly over the short trip. He put in a bad run two starts back, but that was an outlier in what's been a very good season for him. He's had only one start at this track for a win, and although this is slightly harder, he'll take some catching. OWEN THE SAINTS (8) was a good winner last week when able to lead all the way at Shepparton but goes from the front to the back row now, with a few strong runners drawn ahead of him. He must still be respected. WICKED MITZI (5) found a decent draw last time and was able to put her best foot forward in a much stronger race. She draws a little awkwardly but is a winner at this track, which is a plus. OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (1), MISTER JIMARINGLE (4) and LINE DANCE (7) can all map reasonably well and have minor claims. BACK: MAURLEN COMPASS (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MAURLEN COMPASS (2), MAJOR ORION (3), OWEN THE SAINTS (8), WICKED MITZI (5)

OVERVIEW:MUSSEL SHOALS (3) gets a great draw to find the front here, a position where she always delivers her best performances. She led last time over this trip, but that was a much stronger race where she was forced to run a fast time, and she seems less likely to face the same pressure here. She has a good record at this track and will take some catching. WHERES WOOD WOOD (7) is racing in career-best form, and even though she's missed a place in her past three starts, she's still raced honestly. This is her home track, and she loves it here, so while she'll need luck from the draw, she's a strong chance. FLIP A COIN (1) is first up and doesn't have great numerical form, but his best efforts last preparation have him well in this, and he draws to map softly. TALKNPLAY (9) has been in career-best form this preparation, winning three from four. It's a different challenge now from the back row and against some in-form types, but he's in the mix. ARMOURY (6) has been racing well in two runs for the new stable, so keep him safe despite the draw. EEBEEBEE (8) is fitter second up and might be worth considering for the minor money, trailing through off the back row. BACK: MUSSEL SHOALS (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MUSSEL SHOALS (3), WHERES WOOD WOOD (7), FLIP A COIN (1), TALKNPLAY (9)

OVERVIEW:ALTO CORAGGIO (4) has been runner-up in all five career starts, and surely tonight's the night he breaks through for a victory. While he led and had his chance last week, the winner might be pretty good, and you can make a case that he's run well in all his narrow defeats. He looks likely to find the lead here, take control and won't find a more suitable race to break his maiden. THE PRIVATE DEAL (1) will need a scratching to get into the field. He's had three runs for the new stable and has earned market respect despite not looking well suited in most of those races. He now gets a draw and the right opposition to make an impact. He may be a bit tricky at the start, but if he's safely away, he'll be a threat. CARTIMANDUA (2) draws softly with a good driver, and while she'll need to improve on recent efforts, that map prominence will help in a race like this. Likewise for ALCATRAZ MISS (3), a 39-start maiden who's been getting closer in her past few. RISE AGAIN (6) goes to the astute Ashwood stable, which can improve these lower-rated types quickly, so watch the betting. BACK: ALTO CORAGGIO (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALTO CORAGGIO (4), THE PRIVATE DEAL (1), RISE AGAIN (6), CARTIMANDUA (2)

OVERVIEW:SPIRIT OF SPITFIRE (3) is a fascinating runner, being a former New Zealander who had two trials in NSW, switched stables, had a run in Adelaide with a solid SP and now races here with top driver James Herbertson booked. No question she'll attract plenty of market interest, and while you're guessing a bit with what's exposed, the positive indicators suggest she's a strong chance. MAURLEN GRACE (4) was held up badly last week. She was buried back after being slow to begin before galloping when looking a strong chance along the passing lane. There appears to be improvement this preparation, so she's a chance again. ASHANTE WARRIOR (9) has found good form for the Ashwood stable, winning last week in a suitable race, but the draw makes things harder this time. FRESH PRINCE (1) has his second run for the Carbone stable, and while he'll need to lift on that first-up effort, the draw offers a chance to atone. CALIVIL (8) is first up since February and has won a trial leading into this. I'd prefer his chances with more fitness, but don't dismiss him entirely. SELECTIONS:SPIRIT OF SPITFIRE (3), MAURLEN GRACE (4), ASHANTE WARRIOR (9), FRESH PRINCE (1)

OVERVIEW: A tricky start to the Quaddie, with several of these trotters either not in peak form or with fitness to come. FARSTAR (4) goes back to the front row and a draw that saw him lead and win three runs back at Shepparton, albeit in slow time. Having top driver Mark Pitt aboard gives confidence he'll be hard to beat against these. SAINT EYES (2) has gone close in his past couple of runs and draws softly to be in the mix again. His last win in April saw him beat stronger types than he meets now. ITS DIAMOND CREEK (5) is first up for over a year with two trials under his belt and a stable switch back to former trainer Jenny Johnson. He has gate speed and did seem to be nearing another win last preparation. LITTLE TEDEY (6) drops back in class, while ALDEBARAN MARCUS (3) also doesn't tend to win out of turn, but both are worth consideration. SELECTIONS:FARSTAR (4), SAINT EYES (2), ITS DIAMOND CREEK (5), LITTLE TEDEY (6)

OVERVIEW:COLBY ART (8) drops back significantly in class here and has been good in three runs for the new stable. He was a winner two starts back when starting off the back row, scoring in a time that would be good enough to cover these. He trails through behind a speedy beginner, so he shouldn't map too far off them. LORIMERMAJOR (7) likewise finds a more suitable race but hasn't won since the start of the year, although he's been runner-up six times. He has a tricky draw to overcome, but his form is better than most. BERYLS BOOTS (4) goes to the front row and has been much better this season. He'll need some luck with the map, but if he gets cover, he'll be thereabouts. TEMPTING TIGER (1) and POLLY PEACHUM (2) can map softly from their draws but are up in class and have minor claims, while YELLA (5) has burned my fingers too many times. Although he looks suited again, I'd prefer to see him step up before getting involved. BACK: COLBY ART (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:COLBY ART (8), LORIMERMAJOR (7), BERYLS BOOTS (4), TEMPTING TIGER (1)

OVERVIEW:CADENCE LANE (4) likes the standing-start conditions and may find this more suitable than recent outings. Her last win came from the tapes in Adelaide, where she was able to lead, and James Herbertson going aboard only adds confidence to her chances from what appears a suitable map. STARLIGHT RED (2) is a veteran mare suited by the front-row draw and standing-start conditions. She's likely to take up the running around the tighter-turning Echuca track, which is to her advantage given she races well here. Her only win this season came at this track and distance, so she'll give plenty of cheek for a long way. SUZYS DREAM (5) has a strong SP profile this preparation and has been racing consistently, including two seconds at this track. It's a slight concern she's yet to place under standing-start conditions, but her form is better than most. VAN DOREN (6) is her stablemate and does appreciate this track and the conditions. While the numerical form doesn't appeal, the drop in class does suit. MISS AVENGER (1) could have claims for the minor money if she gets away safely. SELECTIONS:CADENCE LANE (4), STARLIGHT RED (2), SUZYS DREAM (5), VAN DOREN (6)

OVERVIEW:ARRAPS (7) normally likes to lead in his races, so won't get that opportunity from this awkward draw, but his current form is hard to overlook in this moderate line-up. He's gone close in better races with a strong SP profile in his past four starts, so while he'll need some luck, with clear running late he can close strongly. ESERANZA (2) can improve sharply on her current form, reunited with Herbertson, as the pair combined for a close 2nd four runs back when able to find the lead from a wider draw than she has here. She can control things from the top end and take plenty of running down. ICANMOTOR (4) narrowly missed two starts ago when runner-up, and while he has a tricky draw, a good driver helps negate that. He can be a threat coming with one run. JOEYS HANGOVER (6) will find this grade more to his liking after mixing his form against stronger types. The draw makes things tricky, but keep him safe. BEYONDREASON (1) is hard to take on form but does get a stable switch and a soft draw, so is worth taking on trust. SELECTIONS:ARRAPS (7), ESERANZA (2), ICANMOTOR (4), JOEYS HANGOVER (6)

KARATA ARTEMIS (7) continues to race in great form and will again look to be driven quietly from barrier seven before storming home strongly late. SNOWIEWILLREV (5) won by a big margin when sitting off the speed in a solid tempo last start and may look to replicate that performance here. He clearly has plenty of ability on his day. REMMINGTON (8) is a late back-row runner who hasn’t had much luck of late. He should follow through the expected leader in LYNRYD SKYNRYD (1) and get his chance in the sprint lane, which may be just what he needs to return to form. MR BONDI (4) showed what he’s capable of with a strong second last start and will look to produce a similar performance here, which would have him right in the finish. IMPERIAL LAZ (6) could win this at his best and is another who will be hoping for some good tempo throughout. Selections: KARATA ARTEMIS (7), SNOWIEWILLREV (5), REMMINGTON (8), MR BONDI (4)

A maiden for the two-year-olds, where MYSTERY MAIL (4) should be breaking his duck after a strong string of performances in recent starts, including a painful watch for connections in the Group 2 Dandy Patch last start. VINJETTA (8) continues to run strong races without winning, and expect she may do something similar again here. BACK YA TRUCK UP (5) looks the best of the debutants after some strong trial performances and should look to sit on speed to give himself every chance. VINCENT THE THIRD (1) and IDEN JUST BECAUSE (2) haven’t been far away of late and will look to take advantage of their nice front-row draws to continue earning cheques for their connections. Selections: MYSTERY MAIL (4), VINJETTA (8), BACK YA TRUCK UP (5), VINCENT THE THIRD (1)

The maiden for the older horses, where you would expect the pole marker, ULTIMATE ATOM (1), to start favourite. She hasn’t had the best of luck in her runs thus far and does look like she may get crossed again here, but with any clear running, she clearly has the ability to take out a race of this class. VITESSE (4) should continue to improve with racing and could be suited by the longer trip here after having no luck last start. HARLEY GLENWOOD (7) was a good run despite the form guide showing a fifth placing last start, having sat wide for the final lap and battled on well. BLISSFULL RED (3) and VOODOO RANGER (5) will look to continue their consistent ways, earning cheques for connections in these sorts of races. Selections: ULTIMATE ATOM (1), VITESSE (4), HARLEY GLENWOOD (7), BLISSFULL RED (3)

ATOMIC BLACK (1) will look to take advantage of the favourable draw here over the short distance. He copped pressure early when crossed last week, where they went an extremely fast time over the middle trip. If he backs up well from that hard run, he looks the one to beat. EVERYTHING BUT THE (2) was nearly run down last start in a similar race and possesses good gate speed to find a nice position on speed and be in the finish. Those two look the fastest off the front row, unless KEAYANG FITZY (7) chances his arm from out wide over the short distance, which could very well happen. RAY DAN (3) was a strong winner two starts back in similar grade before galloping away when favourite in the Golden Apple last week. he should be able to slot in early and find a nice position to be running home strongly. SUPER AMERICAN (4), JOHN VINCENT (5) and MONTGOMERY BURNS (6) have all won or put in strong performances at their past starts and will be relying on some good tempo throughout to allow them to run into the finish from their awkward front-row draws. IRON CLAD (8) could be the one at odds, following the pegs from inside the back row. Selections: ATOMIC BLACK (1), RAY DAN (3), EVERYTHING BUT THE (2), IRON CLAD (8)

A lower-class race over the mile, where COLORADO GIRL (3) will look to use her sharp gate speed to cross those two inside her. She somewhat handed up last week when unable to run down the eventual winner, but suspect she may attempt an all-the-way victory here. JAY MILLER (5) is going for three wins on the trot and has been far too tough for them recently in similar grade. If he can find the death seat without doing too much work early from his awkward front-row draw, he could be too strong again. FIVE STAR SHARK (10) and SWEET AMOUR (11) have both put wins on the board lately and should get a nice run through from their back-row draws, while COOLANDCOLLECT (6) could start at overs from his wide front-row gate but may be running home strongly off a good tempo. Selections: JAY MILLER (5), COLORADO GIRL (3), COOLANDCOLLECT (6), SWEET AMOUR (11)

An even field comes together for the 50–55 rated horses over the sprint trip, where IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (1) will look to make use of her pole draw after drawing awkwardly in recent starts, and put together a sharp mile rate which shes capable of. DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8) should get a nice run through from inside the back row, following out the expected leader and getting his chance. KENYA (9) will no doubt be put into the race from his nice back-row draw and loom as the winner at some stage again. SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11) drops in grade with the claim and could be the one at odds with a strong tempo throughout. EYE SEE AMOUR (2), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (3) and REALLY SMARTIE (5) have all been racing well of late and could be in the finish with a nice run in transit. Selections: IFYALOVEMELETMEGO (1), DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8), KENYA (9), SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11)

Quite a strong open-class race, where we see the return of TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), first-up off the back of an Inter Dominion campaign. There looks to be a strong enough tempo for the first lap, with numerous horses possessing good gate speed off the front row, which should allow him to use his sharp speed late if close enough at the top of the straight. SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11) also resumes after competing in the Vicbred series recently and is another who would be suited by a solid tempo throughout and a nice cart into the race, which may come from CUSTOM HARLEY (9), who is normally driven aggressively at some point. ULTIMACTION (5) didn’t handle the standing-start event last week but was impressive when winning the start prior in nice time. She will be looking to find the pegs here, which may be reliant on whether WATERMELON SUGAR (3) decides to take a sit, as he should have enough speed to cross those inside him. MIKI PINS (2) resumes from a break and clearly has plenty of ability on his day, along with handy gate speed when asked. It’s hard to get a gauge on where he’s at, so the market may be the best guide. FREE THINKER (4) was solid enough first-up in the state and should improve from that run, while there are many other handy horses in the field who could be in the finish with luck in transit. MAGICIAN (1) will also look to take advantage of a rare good front-row draw. Selections: TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11), ULTIMACTION (5), CUSTOM HARLEY (9)

A mile race for no more than three-win mares, where STAYZBETTER (2) will look to kick up from her nice draw and attempt an all-the-way victory. She was a little disappointing last week in the Bandbox Prelude but gets her chance here over the short distance. OUR WILLOW (4) looks well graded and possesses sharp enough gate speed to find a position on speed. At her best, she is more than capable of taking this out. SPORT WATCHER (5) has been very consistent of late and will look to find a position on speed with cover. Those runners look the main fancies and class horses of the field from their draws, while ANGEL ROCKS (7) clearly has plenty of ability but will find it tough from the outside front-row draw. Selections: STAYZBETTER (2), OUR WILLOW (4), SPORT WATCHER (5), ANGEL ROCKS (7)

The usual competitive standing-start event for the middle-class pacers, where again manners will be key. DENVER MAN (3) meets the tapes for the first time and, if he steps safely, could be hard to beat sitting on speed. REPETITIVE (4) is always consistent in these types of races and will again look to find the pegs with his good standing-start manners, as will FLEETWOOD ROCK (2), who could run a race at odds with a soft pegs run. SETTEBELLO (5) normally begins sharply and will no doubt be at each-way odds again. ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8) is among the 10-metre horses who clearly have a class edge over those off the front. They will be relying on a good tempo throughout and a nice run in transit to finish off strongly, with ITSMENOTU (11) possibly looking the best of those chances. Selections: DENVER MAN (3), REPETITIVE (4), ITSMENOTU (11), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8)

Expect the last race on the card to be a quickly run mile, where SOHO TIGER LILY (2) will look to use her sharp gate speed to be first to the pegs and run them along at a handy clip. SHADES OF SILK (3) will no doubt sit on speed and ensure a solid tempo throughout, as he usually does, and is suited by the mile distance. BINALONG MATE (1) is first-up in the state and trialled nicely recently. He should get every chance up the sprint lane on his debut for the new stable to be winning off what looks a solid tempo. FAMILY REASONS (4) is racing well and just needs some luck in running to be in the finish from his front-row draw, while LETSGOBRO (8) has put in two performances good enough to run into the placings if gaps appear late. The same could be said for MOVES LIKE A LADY (10), who will no doubt be ducking through the field late, hoping gaps appear, as usual. A MAJOR STARR (5) has plenty of gate speed and is racing in some excellent form at the moment. He has won two of his last three starts and looks like the one to beat tonight. HEREFORAGOODTIME (2) is a strong chance of holding the lead tonight. He runs his best races when he can lead. DELIGHTFUL DREAM (9), AMIRA MARIE (1) and JUST MOCHA (10) are also chances.

REACH THE PEAK (6) has won his last two starts at Port Pirie from tricky draw. Tonight will be a tougher race but it’s hard to ignore the way he has been racing. He is a strong chance again tonight. FULL BROTHER (1) has the potential to be a major improver tonight from the inside draw. It may pay to keep him safe. FE FE ON FIRE (7) and TUFFASNAILS (9) are also chances.

HARLEM TOWN (6) finds his sort of race tonight. He has been knocking on the door for another win after a strong run at Mildura last start. He is a chance of finding the front as well. HEATHBERN BRUCE (1), ORAMA (4) and CLARENDEN LEGACY (3) are also chances.

FEEL THE MOMENT (4) does her best racing when she is drawn off the front mark in a stand start. If she is anywhere near her best she will be too good for this field. NO REMORSE (2) is another strong performer from the stand start and he looks like a major chance again tonight. BEWARE THE FURY (7) and TINEY (3) are also chances.

NORMY (5) has won his last two starts and he was very impressive last start when he defeated SEASIDE SHOW by 14.3 metres. He looks hard to beat again tonight. CHASE THE STARS (4) is a chance of finding the lead tonight and he finds an easier race tonight. He is a big chance. PLAY IT COOL (1) and KETO (3) are also chances.

SISTER PATRICK (2) has won her last three starts since returning from a spell. She has a big future ahead of her. Tonight is a step up in class but it’s very hard to ignore her recent form. ALDEBARAN DEXTA (9) broke the 2230 metre stand start track record last start. He is a big threat again tonight from the stand start where he does his best racing. REOFFENDER (1) and MY BAD HABITS (4) are also chances.

LOCHINVAR MAGIC (9) sat outside the leader last Monday from the stand start and went on to defeat CHASE THE STARS by 11.9 metres. He looks the one to beat tonight after that impressive run. CLASSIC LINE (2) will be dangerous if he can find the lead early. HAPPY TO YA (6) and LOCHINVAR LEADER (8) are also chances.

NIGHT SPIRIT (6) has won two of his last four starts. He is such a strong performer from the 2230 as well. He will be storming home late tonight if he can get the right run into the race. OHSO KINKY (1) will be a strong chance from the inside draw and she is another who will enjoy the 2230 metre trip. AFTER THE CHASE (9) and ALOHA PRINCESS (10) are also chances.

SWEET NICKY (5) was a strong winner at Port Pirie last start when she defeated ROLL WITH MUSTARD by 10 metres. Tonight will be tougher for her but she looks hard to beat after that win. NORMANS GIRL (3) looks like the main danger. MAJOR LINCOLN (6) and BROBENAH GIRL (1) are also chances.
